extensionName.description: The official name of the extension displayed in the browser's extension manager and web store.

extensionDescription.message: Protect your real inbox by instantly generating and autofilling unique email addresses for every website using your personal domain.
extensionDescription.description: A short summary of what the extension does, displayed in the browser's extension manager.

extensionActionTitle.description: The tooltip text that appears when a user hovers over the extension's icon in the browser toolbar.

optionsPageTitle.description: The text displayed in the browser tab when the user opens the extension's settings page.

optionsHeaderTitle.description: The main heading title at the top of the settings page.

optionsHeaderSubtitle.message: Manage your custom domains for smart email generation.
optionsHeaderSubtitle.description: A short subtitle below the main heading on the settings page explaining the page's purpose.

optionsSettingsHeader.description: The section header for general extension behavior settings.

optionsSyncToggleLabel.message: Enable Firefox Sync (sync settings across devices)
optionsSyncToggleLabel.description: The text label for a toggle switch that turns on cloud synchronization for the user's data.

optionsIncludeTldToggleLabel.description: The text label for a toggle switch determining whether the Top Level Domain (like .com) is included in the generated email alias.

optionsDomainsHeader.description: The section header for managing the user's custom domains.

optionsDomainsDescription.message: Add the domains you want to use for your email aliases.
optionsDomainsDescription.description: Instructions explaining what the domain configuration section is used for.

optionsPrefixInputPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text inside the text input where users can type an optional prefix for their email aliases.

optionsPrefixInputTitle.message: Only letters, numbers, periods, underscores, hyphens, and plus signs are allowed.
optionsPrefixInputTitle.description: The validation error message and tooltip shown when a user enters invalid characters into the prefix field.

optionsPrefixOptionalSuffix.description: A small visual indicator next to the prefix input field telling the user that filling out this field is not strictly required.

optionsDomainInputPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text inside the text input where users type their custom domain name.

optionsDomainInputTitle.message: Please enter a valid domain name (e.g., example.com)
optionsDomainInputTitle.description: The validation error message and tooltip shown when a user enters an improperly formatted domain name.

optionsAddDomainButtonAria.description: The accessibility label and tooltip for the button used to submit and save a new domain.

optionsDomainListEmptyState.message: No domains configured. Add your first domain below.
optionsDomainListEmptyState.description: The message displayed on the settings page when the user has not added any custom domains yet.

optionsDomainSiteIndicator.description: A visual placeholder string shown in the settings menu representing where the active website's name will be injected into the generated email (e.g., prefix[site]@domain.com).

optionsDeleteDomainButtonTitle.description: The tooltip text shown when hovering over the trash can button next to a saved domain.

optionsDeleteDomainButtonAria.description: The accessibility label for the trash can button, indicating exactly which domain will be deleted.

messageDomainsUpdatedSuccess.description: A temporary success message shown on the screen after the user adds, deletes, or reorders a domain.

messageEnterDomainError.description: An error message shown when the user tries to save a new domain but left the domain input field blank.

messageDomainExistsError.message: Domain and prefix combination already exists
messageDomainExistsError.description: An error message shown when the user tries to save a domain and prefix pair that is already in their saved list.

messageSettingsSavedSuccess.description: A temporary success message shown on the screen when the user toggles a general extension setting.

messageSyncEnabledSuccess.description: A temporary success message shown on the screen when the user turns on cloud synchronization.

messageSyncDisabledSuccess.description: A temporary success message shown on the screen when the user turns off cloud synchronization.

popupHeaderTitle.description: The main title displayed at the top of the extension's toolbar popup.

popupSettingsButtonAria.description: The accessibility label and tooltip for the gear icon button in the toolbar popup that opens the settings page.

popupEmptyStateMessage.description: The message displayed in the toolbar popup when the user has not added any custom domains yet.

popupGoToSettingsButton.description: The text on the button in the toolbar popup that redirects users to the configuration page when they have no domains set up.

popupCopyButtonTitle.description: The tooltip shown when hovering over the copy icon next to a generated email alias in the toolbar popup.

messageCopiedToClipboardSuccess.description: A temporary success message shown in the toolbar popup after the user successfully copies an email address.

messageCopyToClipboardFailedError.description: An error message shown in the toolbar popup if the browser prevents the extension from copying the email to the clipboard.

backgroundMenuConfigureSettings.description: The text displayed in the browser's right-click context menu when the user needs to set up the extension for the first time.

backgroundMenuGenerateAliasWithPrefix.description: The text displayed in the browser's right-click context menu showing the exact format of the email that will be generated, including their chosen prefix.

backgroundMenuGenerateAlias.description: The text displayed in the browser's right-click context menu that users click to generate and fill an email alias into a web page.

contentScriptIconAriaLabel.description: The accessibility label for the small icon injected directly into email input fields on web pages.

contentScriptIconTitleMultipleDomains.message: Generate alias (Click or press Enter to cycle options)
contentScriptIconTitleMultipleDomains.description: The tooltip for the small icon injected into email input fields, letting users know they can click repeatedly to cycle through multiple saved domains.

contentScriptIconTitleSingleDomain.description: The tooltip for the small icon injected into email input fields when the user only has one saved domain.
